snippet.title: Peregrino - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Out Now: https://s.team/a/3268150/

Peregrino is a dark isometric survival adventure where you explore a cursed forest by day and manage your caravan by night. Gather resources, hunt deadly creatures, upgrade your caravan, care for your companions, and lead them through the vast wilderness in search of New Eden.

X: https://x.com/InvergeStudios
Discord: https://discord.gg/TXuE4A8nPJ
